title: Memory-retention bug in S3 backend for big files
author: francoa
body_preview: I observed this issue when upgrading from Django 4 to Django 5 (and thus upgrading `django-storages` from 1.12 to 1.14).  I launched a Celery worker in my Kubernetes infra that would upload several big files (200+ MB) to S3 in a short period of time, within a loop.
